## Notes

If you're doing the [Agentic Workflow Redesign demo](../../demos/agentic-workflow-redesign.md), don't add more detail here: capture your baseline manual workflow in a separate issue (Step 1), then write a fully context-engineered spec in another issue (Step 3).
